sec: sec:B006: Prevent unauthorized AI agent actions / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:B006: Prevent unauthorized AI agent actions / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing technical restrictions that limit agent capabilities to authorized scope. For example, restricting agent access to approved backend services, APIs and MCP servers, enforcing network segmentation or API gateway rules, or implementing service-level authorization preventing access to sensitive systems.

sentences.text: Implementing technical restrictions that limit agent capabilities to authorized scope.

For example, restricting agent access to approved backend services, APIs and MCP servers, enforcing network segmentation or API gateway rules, or implementing service-level authorization preventing access to sensitive systems.

blocks.id: blk:B006: Prevent unauthorized AI agent actions / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Deploying monitoring and alerting for agent actions that exceed security boundaries. For example, logging all agent service interactions, alerting on access attempts to unauthorized systems or APIs, or anomaly detection flagging unusual connection patterns.
